case_plans.title: McDonald’s — McHappy Day & Campaign Creative
case_plans.card_summary: Campaign concepts, scripts and channel creative that connected awareness with participation.
case_plans.task: Give a seasonal fundraising campaign a clear path from attention to registration and giving, alongside ongoing product launches.
case_plans.role: Digital strategy, concept and messaging; scripts, banners, social copy, voiceovers and campaign coordination through the agency context.

stages.title: Map the action
stages.text: Connected paid social, website and CRM around one participation journey.

stages.title: Build the message
stages.text: Developed the campaign concept and copy, with channel-specific creative and production direction.

stages.title: Carry it through delivery
stages.text: Coordinated partners and campaign operations; across product launches, managed up to three concurrent campaigns in peak weeks.

case_plans.result: McHappy Day recorded 200K registrations, $230K+ in donations and +20% year-on-year social-audience growth.
case_plans.scope_note: Campaign-wide reported outcomes across the fundraising journey.

case_plans.title: Volkswagen — One Tiguan, Four Takes
case_plans.card_summary: Four Tiguan concepts, from holiday humor to visual storytelling for winter driving.
case_plans.task: Create distinct Tiguan campaigns for outdoor, TV, digital and paid social.
case_plans.role: Created campaign concepts and localized copy. Led a creative pod and coordinated three production houses.

stages.title: Find four angles
stages.text: Use an oversized holiday tree, a portal into another world, a husky in the snow and a 360° driving concept to give each execution a distinct story.

stages.title: Adapt each campaign
stages.text: Developed copy, key visuals and production guidance for outdoor, TV, digital and paid social.

case_plans.result: A set of four creative directions and campaign executions across formats.
case_plans.scope_note: Agency campaign work for Volkswagen through Leo Burnett.

case_plans.title: Coca-Cola / Fanta — Taste This Winter
case_plans.card_summary: A multi-video animated campaign built from concepts, scripts, storyboards and a repeatable visual world.
case_plans.task: Expand one seasonal idea into distinct short stories with clear product moments.
case_plans.role: Concepts, scripts, key visuals, storyboards and creative direction for animated storytelling.

stages.title: Find the story engine
stages.text: Developed campaign concepts and scripts for the multi-video “Taste This Winter” series.

stages.title: Make the world

stages.title: Shape the cut
stages.text: Directed pacing, product reveal and brand hold; explored a tighter proposed 15-second CTV presentation study.

case_plans.scope_note: Original film frames and campaign creative; the 15-second CTV edit is a proposed portfolio study.

case_plans.title: SCREAM 7 — Paramount Pictures × Complex Art Competition
case_plans.card_summary: A five-work poster series; “IN PROGRESS” selected for the official Complex Los Angeles exhibition.
case_plans.task: Create fresh tension inside a familiar film franchise without relying on the same mask image every time.
case_plans.role: Concept development, visual storytelling, art direction and design for an independent competition entry.

stages.title: Explore the tension
stages.text: Developed visual metaphors around the phone, surveillance, identity and the audience’s role in watching.

stages.title: Build the series
stages.text: Created a five-work competition series with reusable image and type elements.

stages.title: Refine for impact
stages.text: Reviewed legibility, franchise recognition and the strength of each idea in a gallery setting.

case_plans.result: Official competition winner; “IN PROGRESS” was selected for the Complex Los Angeles exhibition in February 2026.
case_plans.scope_note: Competition entry: one selected work from the original five-work series. Paramount and Complex identify the competition context.
case_plans.hero_caption: Cloud Ghostface / landscape adaptation of original poster

case_plans.title: Cal Poly DxHub × AWS — EHS Mentor

stages.title: Design the workflow and interface
stages.text: Defined user roles, safety-training requirements, assignments, administrative views and progress reporting.

stages.title: Configure the AI environment
stages.text: Set up servers and configured Amazon Bedrock during the program.

stages.title: Build and test the prototype
stages.text: Implemented document processing, assignment tracking and completion reporting with Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker and Render.

case_plans.result: Developed and presented a working prototype. Selected for a cohort of 100 from nearly 1,300 applicants.
case_plans.scope_note: Working Python/FastAPI prototype with hands-on Amazon Bedrock configuration completed during the program.

case_plans.title: VERIFY YOU ARE HUMAN
case_plans.card_summary: A Pinocchio poster that turns a familiar verification screen into a question about being human.
case_plans.task: Reinterpret Pinocchio for an international poster exhibition marking 200 years since Carlo Collodi’s birth.
case_plans.role: Poster concept, art direction, typography and final artwork.

stages.title: Find a contemporary test
stages.text: Used the familiar “I’m human” checkbox to connect Pinocchio’s wish to become human with the way screens ask us to prove it.

stages.title: Put the metaphor in the image
stages.text: Paired a wooden hand and a lengthening nose with a smartphone, using the nose as the pointer for the verification screen.

case_plans.result: Selected for the international exhibition and catalogue.
case_plans.scope_note: Museo MAGMA’s selection notice named exhibitions in Italy, Argentina and Cuba and inclusion in the catalogue and archive. The international jury selected 200 posters from more than 500 submissions.
